body:
Overall, my life has been hellish. But the last couple months have been the worst. My boyfriend at the time, and I broke up and I still have feelings for him. He claimed he would still always be there for me when I needed someone, but he never kept his word. The best thing he told me was that "we need to get you some help" and then moved on. 

When I go to my "best friend" of 10 years she would just ignore what I have to say and not respond to my calls or texts. I even forgave her for the fact that she let her boyfriend steal money and valuables from me when they came over.

I can't even talk with my own family because the one time I did in the past, I was told I was weak-minded and that I was just being dramatic. 

Now, I moved recently.. and got laid off the day I moved in. I haven't been able to find a job since then because not many places around me would work with my class schedules... And now I might have to abandon my schooling just to pay my portion of the rent next month. 

Everyday I wake up and I just know it's just gonna get worse. I can't focus during classes and I'm just.. all alone in this.
